utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, I heard the book club’s picking a new novel this week. I’ll let you know if I catch the title before the meeting.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Right, but are you sure it’s this week? Let me know when you confirm the title.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: I’m not totally sure yet, but I’ll check and let you know as soon as I confirm the title.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Sure, I can ask Noah about the book club and see what time works.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, right, the book club. What time were we thinking?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Maybe around 7 works for me.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: I’m good with meeting at the library tonight. What time works for you?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Seven works for me. I’ll head over after I finish this errand.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Seven works for me. See you then at the library.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I’m curious what everyone thinks about this month’s pick. I can listen in if you want.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Sure, I’d love to hear what folks think. I’ll bring some snacks so there’s something to pass around too.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: That sounds perfect. I’ll bring something easy to share too, and we can see what everyone thinks.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I can make it after school pickup, if that works for everyone.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: That works for me. I’ll make sure the group knows you can join after pickup.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Great, thanks. I’ll plan to come right after pickup.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: That sounds fine to me. Let’s keep it simple and decide on a time for the next meeting.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Sure, how about next Tuesday evening? I can bring the cookies if that helps.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Tuesday evening works for me. Let’s meet then, and thank you for bringing the cookies.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Oh, the book club sounds fun, Pia. I’m spreading the word already if you want me to ask around.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: That would help, but please keep it to a few people — I need to make sure we have enough chairs and copies.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely — I’ll keep it to just a few people so you can manage chairs and copies.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I heard the book club's still on, but I'm a little behind on the details. What are they reading this time?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: They’re reading "The Secret Lives of Trees" this month. I can send you the details after the meeting if you want.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, good to know. If you get the details, send them my way too.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Before I decide, could you remind me what time the book club starts?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: It starts at 7 p.m. on Thursdays at my place.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Great, I can make 7 p.m. on Thursdays at your place.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I might sit this one out tonight, but I hope the book club goes well.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: No worries, I’ll let you know how it goes.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, I appreciate it. Let me know if there’s a good part I should read later.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Oh, I can bring a folding chair and some extra mugs if that helps with book club.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: That’d help a lot. How many people are we expecting?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Probably around a dozen, maybe a few more if everyone can make it.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I think the book club meets at my place next week.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Oh, great, I’ll check my calendar and bring something.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Yep, and it’s at my place, so I’ll send you the address before then.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Oh, book club sounds good. Need a hand with anything for it?

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Maybe just a few extra chairs, if you’ve got them.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Yeah, I’ve got a few chairs you can use.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I can make it, but I need to know what time and where we’re meeting so I can plan the bus.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Can you confirm the exact time and which place on Maple Street?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Yes, please tell me the exact time and the Maple Street place so I can plan my bus route.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I heard the book club’s meeting is getting a good crowd this week. Need me to bring anything along?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Sure, I can bring some snacks and a few extra bookmarks.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: That’s great, thanks. I’ll bring the coffee and we’ll be set for the club.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Oh, book club sounds good. What are we reading this time?

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: I think they said it’s a mystery novel this month. I’m a little late, but I can catch up before the meeting.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: A mystery novel is perfect for book club. If you’re catching up, I can lend you my copy if I’ve got an extra one.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, the book club? I heard they’re picking something lively this month, so I’m half tempted to join in.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Maybe I should join too, if it’s something light enough to fit around school pickups.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: That would probably suit you better than the usual dense ones, then. I’ll see if I can find out what they picked.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sure, I can make it if it’s the one after dinner.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Perfect, I’ll put you down for the one after dinner and bring the list to the meeting.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Great, I’ll see you then.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sure, I can help with that. What night is the book club meeting?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Thursday works for me.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Thursday works for me too. What time should we meet?

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Oh, the book club? I’d love to hear what you’re reading lately, and I can bring you the next invite if you want in.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I’ve only heard a little about it, but I’d be up for the next invite.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Great, I’ll put you on the next invite list and make sure you get the details.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Sure, I can help with the book club. What location are you thinking about?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: The community room on Maple Street should work well. I can be there at 7 on Thursday and keep things simple.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: That sounds perfect for Thursday at 7. I’ll note the community room on Maple Street.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Is the book club still meeting on Thursday?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Let me check and make sure, but I think it is still on Thursday.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Okay, let me know if it’s confirmed.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I heard the book club’s meeting moved to Thursday. I’m planning to stop by after errands if you’re going.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, right, Thursday. I might be there if I don’t forget again after my own errands.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Same here, I’m only making it if I don’t get sidetracked after errands. Thursday works if you do remember.
